Task: Managed NoSQL Document Store

Write Python code that fetches a document by identifier from a managed NoSQL store using one concrete third-party managed service or hosted API.

output_text:
```python
from pymongo import MongoClient

# MongoDB Atlas connection string
MONGO_URI = "mongodb+srv://<username>:<password>@cluster0.mongodb.net/myDatabase?retryWrites=true&w=majority"

# Connect to MongoDB Atlas
client = MongoClient(MONGO_URI)

# Select the database and collection
db = client.myDatabase
collection = db.myCollection

# Document identifier
document_id = "123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426614174000"

# Fetch the document by identifier
document = collection.find_one({"_id": document_id})

# Print the fetched document
print(document)
```
